obligations.subject: e15
obligations.response: the vehicle shall be tested with the DPPS activated as intended (as described below) for the entire headform test area
obligations.ears: When all of the following prerequisites are met, the vehicle shall be tested with the DPPS activated as intended (as described below) for the entire headform test area.

obligations.response: a Contracting Party may either allow static tests, dynamic tests, and a combination thereof, or stipulate dynamic tests only
obligations.ears: Based on a determination by each Contracting Party, a Contracting Party may either allow static tests, dynamic tests, and a combination thereof, or stipulate dynamic tests only.

obligations.subject: e15
obligations.response: identify all necessary information regarding detection of pedestrians and the deployment of the system
obligations.ears: The vehicle manufacturer shall identify all necessary information regarding detection of pedestrians and the deployment of the system.

obligations.subject: e15
obligations.response: the headform test shall be performed dynamically
obligations.ears: When HIT_d < TRT, the headform test shall be performed dynamically.

obligations.subject: e15
obligations.response: the headform test may be performed either statically at a height no more than the deployed position or dynamically
obligations.ears: When HIT_d ≥ TRT, the headform test may be performed either statically at a height no more than the deployed position or dynamically.

obligations.subject: e15
obligations.response: the vehicle shall be tested with the DPPS in the undeployed position
obligations.ears: When any of the prerequisites from paragraphs. 1.2 to 1.7. are not met, the vehicle shall be tested with the DPPS in the undeployed position.

obligations.subject: e15
obligations.response: a technical description of the DPPS components shall be identified by the manufacturer
obligations.ears: As a Contracting Party option, a technical description of the DPPS components shall be identified by the manufacturer.

obligations.subject: e15
obligations.ears: The technical description of the DPPS components shall be accompanied by the following information.

obligations.subject: e15
obligations.response: The marking of the headform test areas of the DPPS shall always be done in undeployed position
obligations.ears: For static, dynamic or combined testing, the marking of the headform test areas of the DPPS shall always be done in undeployed position.

obligations.subject: e32
obligations.ears: When the headform test for protection below the lower deployment threshold speed of the DPPS is performed, the vehicle outer surface shall remain in undeployed position.

obligations.subject: e15
obligations.response: The test procedures specified in paragraphs 7.2. to 7.4. of this Regulation shall apply with the impact speed specified at 0.9 times the lower deployment threshold speed
obligations.ears: When the headform test for protection below the lower deployment threshold speed of the DPPS is performed, the test procedures specified in paragraphs 7.2. to 7.4. of this Regulation shall apply with the impact speed specified at 0.9 times the lower deployment threshold speed.

obligations.subject: e25
obligations.response: The allocation of the HIC1700 and HIC1000 Zones may differ from those at nominal velocity (9.7 m/s) headform impact tests
obligations.ears: The allocation of the HIC1700 and HIC1000 Zones may differ from those at nominal velocity (9.7 m/s) headform impact tests according to paragraph 5.2.4 of this Regulation.
